title: Auth Discoverer: AI-Driven Recipe Builder from Fingerprint
goal: Add an AI-driven function that takes the fingerprint from task #375 and produces an executable auth recipe (sequence of HTTP requests with field mappings, expected status codes, and a verification step that confirms a session was established).
scope: Extend api/app/services/auth_discoverer.py with build_recipe(fingerprint) -> AuthRecipe. Uses Claude Haiku (cheap) for recipe synthesis. Recipe is a structured object that any runner can execute via existing HTTP primitives. No probe-side migration in this task.
generation_reason: Fingerprint alone is not actionable; runners need an executable recipe (which fields to fill, in what order, against which endpoint, with what verification). The existing xss_proof/runner.py:_try_register_with_ai produces this for one runner; extract and generalize as a shared service.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Recipe builder only. Do NOT add caching (task #377). Do NOT migrate probes (task #378). Do NOT touch the picker.
constraints.model_choice: Use claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 for cost efficiency. Single short prompt. No tool use loop.
constraints.no_recipes_in_code: Per feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes memory: do not seed app-specific recipes in code. AI must derive recipes from the fingerprint at runtime.

success_criteria: build_recipe(fingerprint) returns a structured AuthRecipe with steps: list of HTTP-request descriptors with field mappings.
Recipe includes a verification step that detects successful auth (e.g. cookie set, redirect to /home, response contains username).
Recipe is JSON-serializable so it can later be cached.
AI prompt does NOT include any Gruyere-, juice-shop-, or testfire-specific recipe text. Discovery only from fingerprint.
Unit tests with mocked Claude responses cover at least 3 fingerprint shapes.

acceptance_criteria: Recipe shape matches a typed contract usable by any runner.
AI prompt source contains no hardcoded app-specific patterns.
Module is unit-testable without live HTTP.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
backlog-375 form detection must be merged.

out_of_scope: Replay-with-verification logic (covered by recipe verification step + task #378 integration).
